name: Cheng 2022 SKB264/sac-TMT TROP2 ADC scenarios
description: Exact source table/scalar replay plus exploratory calibrated Figure 4/5 tumor-growth ODE scenarios from digitized public curves.

scenarios.name: Source status and identity

scenarios.name: PK/PD and efficacy study design
scenarios.description: Dose, sample size, timing, and TGI method constants from Methods.

scenarios.description: Reported TGI, release-rate, PDX, and comparator scalars from Results.
